Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: HARzazz
rows.Bloom: Amber.. Strong fragrance. up to 50 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), quartered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 35" to 39" (90 to 100cm). Width: 2' to 26" (60 to 65cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Heirloom Old Garden Roses says Lady Jane Grey™ has old-style many petaled (at times almost quartered) blooms whose color is rose amber overlaid with blush pink with an inner hint of honey...
